approaches.title: Minimum-value and duplicate-smallest-odd check
approaches.summary: Finds the smallest odd value and the overall minimum, then checks whether the minimum is already odd or the smallest odd appears at least twice. Revision 2 preserves this strategy while terminating early when a second occurrence is found.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements the solution by comparing the smallest odd element with the overall minimum and counting occurrences of the smallest odd value.

revisions.commitComment: terminate early on first found pair
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3876: terminate early on first found pair
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Optimizes the duplicate check to stop after finding the second occurrence of the smallest odd value instead of counting all matches.
